# p5.js runtime

p5.js 1.11.11 and its bundled p5.sound addon, from the official npm package:
https://registry.npmjs.org/p5/-/p5-1.11.11.tgz

The package SHA-512 integrity was verified before copying these files. Files are served locally so the artwork does not depend on a CDN at runtime. See LICENSE.txt and the library headers for licensing.
